interface.shortDescription: Voice conversation SDK skills and CLI tools for launching and interacting with realtime voice agents.
interface.longDescription: Troubleshooting and detailed usage skills for the voice MCP server: browser/audio problems, conversation lifecycle (pause/resume/reset), context management, intervening when the avatar is wrong, the full-viewport HTML stage, ending a session, and startup/channel failures.
